guarantees.claim: When rst_ni is low, cfg_block is cleared to 0.
When hash_start_or_continue is true and not in reset, cfg_block is set to 1 on the next clock edge.
When reg_hash_done or reg_hash_stop is true, and not in reset, and hash_start_or_continue is false, cfg_block is set to 0.
When none of the above conditions apply and not in reset, cfg_block holds its previous value.
guarantees.cond: !rst_ni == 1 and hash_start_or_continue == 0 and reg_hash_done == 0 and reg_hash_stop == 0

uncertain_points.claim: When hash_start_or_continue is true in the same cycle as reg_hash_done or reg_hash_stop, the start condition takes priority and sets cfg_block to 1. This may cause cfg_block to remain high after a stop/completion, potentially extending the configuration-block enable longer than intended.
uncertain_points.cond: Simultaneous assertion of hash_start_or_continue and (reg_hash_done or reg_hash_stop)
uncertain_points.risk: Unintended hash configuration continuation or glitch.
